decision: A five-column board with drag and drop, and a drop zone that shows where a card lands
why: Moving applications is spatial; forms hide the flow.
value: Updating the pipeline takes one gesture.

decision: Outcome logging is a sub-modal over the application drawer
why: The outcome depends on the application context the drawer shows.
value: Context stays visible; the URL reproduces both layers.

decision: Saving an outcome emits one event that moves the card and schedules practice
why: Several products react to an outcome; they should not each be called directly.
alternative: Update the card and call Arena synchronously.

decision: The AI turns what they asked into a matching Arena prompt
why: The best practice question is the one you were just asked.

decision: Each application links to its prep prompt and last score
why: Readiness is per role, not global.
value: People prepare for the interview in front of them.
